verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Hummingbird ingesting alerts from external monitoring systems through its Alerts API and grouping them into cases. It also mentions 'customizable automation' for screening and ongoing monitoring in general marketing terms. Nothing documents configuring transaction monitoring rules or segment-specific thresholds inside the product, so this story is unsupported.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure transaction monitoring rules and segment-specific thresholds
